The '''KT4 [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]''' was manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. The [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telegorn]] [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] mounted eight of the cannons.
